question_text: Was the Staples Canada print website breach a hack?
answer_text: Yes, by Staples' own account: an unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission between Nov 1 and Nov 5 and had access to customer information. Who did it is not known.
label: Confirmed

question_text: What information was involved in the Staples Canada breach?
answer_text: Names, email addresses, shipping and billing addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords. Staples says no financial information was exposed.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Do I need to change my Staples Print password?
answer_text: Staples says affected customers will be asked to reset it at next login, and advises unique passwords on every site. If you reused that password elsewhere, change it there too.
label: Reported

question_text: Is this the same as the extortion claim against Staples, Inc.?
answer_text: No link has been shown. The claim concerns the US company, was posted earlier, and Staples, Inc. has not confirmed it.
label: Not established
